task.question: Who was appointed as the next music director of the San Francisco Symphony on May 21, 2026?
task.evidence: 21 May - The San Francisco Symphony announces the appointment of Elim Chan as its next music director, the first female conductor ever named to the post effective with the 2027-2028 season, with an initial contract of six years.
